description: `version/parser.rb` + a driver over the parser hierarchy. The slice's one piece of classical OO -- an `abstract!` base, `RegexParser` holding a regexp and an optional block, and two subclasses that differ only in `process_spec`. Tier 7's `super`, tier 10's mixin ancestry and tier 14's `&block` parameter, over a receiver whose method is found three classes up. Also the file that exposed the boot-stub gap the ratchet had to close: with only `Object#blank?` stubbed, `nil.blank?` is *false* and `RegexParser#parse` is unusable -- see `scripts/build_slice_rungs.py`'s `BLANK_NIL_STUB`.

ast: == UrlParser matches against the whole URL
== StemParser matches against the *stem*, and picks it three ways
== the optional block post-processes the capture
== no match, and an empty capture, both answer nil
== the abstract base is abstract, and RegexParser has no process_spec
